name: hub-at-broadcast
description: The @ menu leads with @broadcast (this project), @local-broadcast (this computer) and @global-broadcast (the network). @local-broadcast reaches an agent in another folder; @broadcast does not; off a network the global one says no other computer was reached.

setup.description: throwaway HOME: app folder ws/, an agent running in other/
setup.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-at-broadcast"; [ -d "$H/other" ] && (cd "$H/other" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --hub stop all); true >/dev/null 2>&1; R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-at-broadcast"; rm -rf "$H"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab" "$H/ws" "$H/other"; printf '%s' '{"kollabor":{"llm":{"active_profile":"openai-test","profiles":{"openai-test":{"provider":"openai","model":"gpt-5.5","base_url":"https://api.openai.com/v1","api_key":"sk-test-dummy","supports_tools":true}}}},"plugins":{"hub":{"enabled":true}}}' > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; touch "$H/.kollab/connect-guide-seen"; (cd "$H/other" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --detached >/dev/null 2>&1)

steps.pattern: @global-broadcast\s.*every agent on every computer in your network
broadcast to [0-9]+ agent\(s\); 1 in other folders
steps.description: the agent in other/ took it
the other folder's agent has the message
steps.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-at-broadcast"; cd "$H/other" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --hub capture koordinator 5

steps.pattern: 1 in other folders; no other computers on your network yet
steps.description: reaches other/ and says no other computer was reached
typed as is (a space keeps what was typed)

steps.pattern: (?s)no other computers on your network yet.*broadcast to [0-9]+ agent\(s\)(?!; )

steps.description: other/ never got the project broadcast
steps.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-at-broadcast"; cd "$H/other" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --hub capture koordinator 10

steps.description: the same capture shows @global-broadcast reached other/

teardown.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-hub-at-broadcast"; [ -d "$H/other" ] && (cd "$H/other" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --hub stop all); true
